mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AEO for a pest control website?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing results from AEO can vary based on several factors, including the competitiveness of your local market, the existing authority of your website, and the comprehensiveness of your optimization efforts. Generally, businesses may start to see initial improvements in featured snippet visibility and voice search traffic within 3 to 6 months. Significant improvements in lead generation and overall organic visibility often take 6 to 12 months as search engines re-index and re-evaluate your optimized content. Consistent effort in creating high-quality, answer-focused content is crucial for sustained success.
